name: OpenCode Usage
author: srsergio
description: Unofficial bar widget for opencode-go: rolling 5h / weekly 7d / monthly 30d with model breakdown. No service key, just workspace + auth cookie.

barWidget.description: Shows rolling 5h / weekly / monthly and resetInSec via stable HTML. No oc_sk_ needed.

schema.label: Workspace ID
schema.description: ID like wrk_... from https://opencode.ai/workspace/<id>/usage (empty = set in settings)

schema.label: Auth cookie
schema.description: Value of auth=... cookie (DevTools → Application → Cookies → auth). Empty = ERR until configured. Expires ~1 year.

schema.label: Server ID (auto)
schema.description: Auto-discovered from workspace HTML on first load. Empty = auto-discover, no manual update needed.

schema.label: Details Server ID (auto)
schema.description: Auto-discovered from workspace /go HTML on details fetch. Empty = auto-discover, no manual update needed.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Auto: connected if auth+workspace valid and last fetch OK, disconnected on ERR. Read-only — updated by widget.
